instruction: We're facing towards a white dresser, on the right there's a window, on top of the dresser there's a decoration, and behind the dresser there are two pictures, turn slightly to the left and walk pass the dresser, towards the dining area... We're facing towards a wall with a mirror in the middle, turn slightly to the right and walk pass the white wall... Once you pass the white wall, take two steps further, you'll be facing a hallway, on the left there'll be a kitchen island with four chairs and on your right there will cabinets, and that's your destination.
